Owned synthetic query fixtures, generated by `../generate_query_fixtures.py`
through the actual Python `PreparationOperations`, `BaselineOperations` and
`ProjectStore` on Python 3.15.1. No hardware or private data.

Both SQLite encodings start at main schema v5 with monitoring v4. Five source
cases include 735 retained high-cadence captures, genuine ROWID holes, native
Unicode ID ties, offset timestamp text, empty/short/zero-period cases and a
century-scale collection. The Rust migration backfills ingestion in ID order,
which intentionally differs from original `sweeps.rowid`.

The JSON oracle contains compact selection/count/span/cadence, position/pending
metadata and scoped event/evidence results. The separate 2596-vector oracle
records exact Python timedelta float multiplication and seconds conversion.
